verifications.note: 'When completed, Falcon's Hill-Lake Pipeline will operate at a maximum pressure of 1200 psig and will have a maximum capacity of more than 300,000 Mcf per day.' (Falcon Gas Storage press release, 2001-07-30) -- exact match to recorded 300000.00 Mcf/d, names the Hill-Lake Pipeline directly.

'Phase I expansions ... used to construct a 16-mile, 300,000 Mcfd, high-pressure pipeline connecting Hill-Lake to the 36-inch Lone Star Line "X" (now Atmos Energy Line "X") and the 36-inch Gulfterra/TUFCO ... North Texas pipelines.' -- Oil & Gas Journal, independent of the 2001 wire release, states the identical 300,000 Mcfd figure for the same pipeline (connecting Hill-Lake to Line X / North Texas Pipeline, matching this row's endpoints).

resolutions.researcher_notes: Recorded Capacity=300000.00 Mcf/d for the Hill-Lake Pipeline (Falcon/Hill-Lake to Lone Star Line X + North Texas Pipeline) is corroborated by two independent sources stating the identical figure: (1) the already-cited 2001 Falcon Gas Storage press release (hydrocarbononline.com, re-verified live, 200 + exact phrase present) and (2) an Oil & Gas Journal retrospective on Falcon's financial history, found independently via web search, which states the Phase I expansion built a '16-mile, 300,000 Mcfd' pipeline to the same interconnects. class_out=REVERIFIED (existing ref re-confirmed) with the OGJ URL added as a second independent corroborating ref, upgrading this cell from single-source to 2-independent/high. Note: oilandgasonline.com's copy of the same URL slug is the identical wire story republished on a sister VertMarkets site -- not counted as independent, not added. Distinguish from a DIFFERENT number appearing on nortexmidstream.com/facilities and its 2020 archived predecessor: those state Hill-Lake GAS STORAGE FACILITY's Maximum Daily Withdrawal/Injection (MDWQ/MDIQ) = 350,000 Mcf/d each -- a separate facility-level withdrawal/injection spec, not this row's pipeline throughput capacity; not a contradiction, just a different asset/metric, so not proposed as a ref for this cell. The FERC and RRC Statements of Operating Conditions (archived PDFs) are general tariff terms-and-conditions documents with no explicit numeric pipeline-capacity figure in the extracted text (rate schedules/exhibits likely carry facility-specific quantities in tables not captured by text extraction); opened and checked, nothing usable for this unit.
